title: Reload Features by Card Type, Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards
content:
Within the Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards program, value can be added after issue to one card type only: the Northgate Reloadable Gift Card. Its smallest reload is 10.00 USD, it can be reloaded in store or online, and it can be reloaded at most 2 times a day. The other five types are not reloadable, so they have no reload minimum, no reload channel and a daily reload figure of 0.

## Feature sheet

| Card type | Value can be added after issue | Smallest reload (USD) | Where a reload can be made | Most reloads per day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Gift Card | no | not applicable | none | 0 |
| Northgate eGift Card | no | not applicable | none | 0 |
| Northgate Merchandise Return Card | no | not applicable | none | 0 |
| Northgate Promotional Gift Card | no | not applicable | none | 0 |
| Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card | no | not applicable | none | 0 |
| Northgate Reloadable Gift Card | yes | 10.00 | in store, online | 2 |

## Questions the sheet answers

**Can value be added to a Northgate eGift Card after it is issued?** No. Only the Northgate Reloadable Gift Card takes value after issue.

**Is a reload of 10.00 large enough on a Northgate Reloadable Gift Card?** Yes; 10.00 is the smallest reload, so a reload of exactly 10.00 qualifies and a reload of 9.99 does not.

**Can a Northgate Reloadable Gift Card be reloaded through the app?** The reload channels for the type are in store and online only.

## Illustration (hypothetical day)

A Northgate Reloadable Gift Card reloaded once in the morning and once at midday has used the 2 reloads the type allows that day; a third reload on the same day is above the figure.
